text.aria-label: Placed here — 检查者放在这里
Lets go — 松开手腕
The patient cannot hold it: — 病人保持不住，
the forearm drifts back toward the belly — 前臂往腹部方向回漂

text.aria-label: Hornblower sign (front view) — Hornblower 征（前面观）
The examiner supports the arm at 90° of abduction in the scapular plane, elbow bent 90°; — 检查者托住手臂：肩胛平面外展 90°、屈肘 90°；

text.aria-label: the patient turns the forearm up (external rotation) against the examiner's hand. — 病人对抗检查者的手，把前臂向上转（外旋）。
